column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 diary / Michette

column2: Month ○, Day × — Sunny
Today, $$おにいちゃん$$ $$かいん$$...
gave me a friend...
$$かいん$$ is the teddy bear my beloved $$おにいちゃん$$ gave me!!
$$ミシェット$$ was so happy...
So happy, so happy, so happy!
I promised $$おにいちゃん$$... I'd treasure him very much...!
But why do I have to keep $$おにいちゃん$$ a secret...?
Month △, Day ○ — Rainy
Today, $$おにいちゃん$$ $$かいん$$...
When I asked him to marry me, he looked so surprised and said... we couldn't get married, but...
he said he'd become $$ミシェット$$'s $$どれい$$, and patted my head...
But what is a $$どれい$$? I don't really understand it, but...
It seems it's because of the color of $$おにいちゃん$$'s $$おはね$$...
But even when I really think about it, I still don't get it...!
I don't have a papa or mama...
So nobody ever tells me anything...
Month ◇, Day ◎ — Cloudy
$$おにいちゃん$$ $$かいん$$...
He said that at this year's festival, he'd become a $$いけにえ$$ for sure, and he was smiling so happily...!
But...
I don't know what a $$いけにえ$$ is, but...
$$おにいちゃん$$ was so happy...
so it must be something really, really cool, I think...
So on the day of the festival...
$$おにいちゃん$$ promised to take me with him...
Absolutely, absolutely... it's a promise, okay...
Month □, Day × — Thunderstorm
Today's the festival day we promised about...
$$おにいちゃん$$ broke his promise
and didn't come pick $$みしぇっと$$ up...
Did $$おにいちゃん$$ catch a cold? Or did he start to hate $$ミシェット$$...?!
Maybe it wasn't supposed to be today after all...
We promised, didn't we!?
We promised, didn't we...!?
Fine...
...I hate $$おにいちゃん$$ so, so much...
Month ○, Day ■ — Rainy
It's been more than a month since then, but...
$$おにいちゃん$$ $$かいん$$ hasn't come to see me...!
People around me make fun of me, saying I trust people too easily...
Maybe $$おにいちゃん$$ feels bad about breaking his promise, so he won't come see me...!?
Or did he start to hate $$ミシェット$$...?! It's fine. I still believe in him...
I'm sure one day... $$おにいちゃん$$ will come and pick me up...
